edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: The severe end of statin muscle toxicity likely reflects impaired muscle-cell energy production and, in some cases, high circulating drug levels from interacting medications or genetic susceptibility.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2025 Kovacic meta analysis in J Nutr Sci, which ties statins to myopathy in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
